_readme: The ONLY place contact details live. Edit here, then run: node _build/build.mjs --release. Null values are left off the site (never shown as placeholders). --release refuses to build while phone is null.

whatsapp._note: Set e164 to the WhatsApp Business number (digits, with country code) and verified to true only after a test message has reached the business inbox. Until then no WhatsApp button is rendered.

pricing._note: Proposed bands from the Phase 1 report. Figures are only published when approved is true.

bands.hours: 6pm to 10pm on weekdays; 8am to 10pm at weekends
